content.text: Heading "פיקדון": this is what I came for. Big number "68,270 ₪"... with 10,000 plus 500 a month, "בכסף של היום". OK, nice.

content.thinking: ההפקדה שלכם 70,000 ₪ בשנה 10 נשארת על 68,270 ₪, ואני בודק למה, כולל קנס שבירת פיקדון וההיעדר של ביטוח פיקדונות.
הסכום לא מופיע בדף: רק "דמי יציאה" לפי התעריפון, ותנאי קנס לשבירת פיקדון לפני הזמן, כמו גם מס של 15%. אזהרה: אם בנק קורס, החוק לא מחזיר את הכסף.

content.text: Glossary... "קנס שבירה": "מוחקת את הריבית ואף חלק מהסכום שהופקד". So that's what you give up. Last one, a quick look.

**What I'd tell my friend:** I got the idea but I'm not putting money in a deposit. It's pretty clear: you lock the money in the bank for a set time and get interest. The page's example uses 1.8% a year. The bank takes 15% tax off the interest. If you take the money out early there's a penalty that can wipe out the interest, and sometimes part of the money too. The thing that decided it was the big number: you put in 70,000 ₪ over 10 years and end up with 68,270 ₪. To me that looks like losing money. Then I saw "אין ביטוח פיקדונות", meaning if the bank goes under nobody has to give you the money back. Scary. I'm fairly sure about what a deposit is. I'm less sure I read the 68,270 right. Small print next to it says "בכסף של היום" and there's an inflation box with "2", so maybe that's the reason. I didn't work it out.

**How it went:**
- **Order I looked:** The heading "פיקדון" and its first lines told me what it is: money parked for a set time, interest fixed or variable. Then the calculator box with the big 68,270 ₪. Then the chart and the year-10 lines "נשאר לכם 68,270", "מס 986.20" and "ההפקדות שלכם 70,000". Then the inputs, interest 1.8 and inflation 2.
- **Next:** I read the lines under "למה משתמשים בזה" and "שווה לדעת" ("שבירת פיקדון... העלות", "אין ביטוח פיקדונות"). Then "כמה זה עולה". It only says "דמי יציאה" and "לפי התעריפון", with no number at all.
- **Then:** the tax cards (15%), the red box about breaking a deposit early, and the line saying a failed bank doesn't have to give the money back. I only skimmed the glossary and stopped at "קנס שבירה". The footer I just scrolled past.
- **Skipped:** "מי מציע ומי מספק", the "הצגת החוקים והכללים" links, the "הצגה כטבלה" and "הצגת כל הבדיקות" folds, the small grey notes under the inputs, the TXI/BANK tags, and the "פטור למעוט הכנסה" paragraph.
- **Words I didn't get:** "צמוד למדד", "הבטחת קרן", "מק"מ", "מצרי שוק הכסף", "חשבון במערכת סגורה", "ריבית הפריים", the tags like "TXI-03" and "BANK-06", and "ריאלית".
- **What bothered me:**
  - Ending up with less than I put in, with no clear sentence saying why.
  - The cost section has no shekel amount, and the early-exit penalty isn't calculated anywhere.
  - Nothing tells me what a deposit would actually pay today at a real bank.

If I hadn't come for this on purpose, I'd have closed the page after "אין ביטוח פיקדונות".

input.answer: A deposit locks your money in a bank for a set time for interest (the example uses 1.8%). 15% tax comes off the interest, and breaking it early can cost the interest and even part of the money. But the example shows 70,000 ₪ in and 68,270 ₪ out, and there's no deposit insurance, so I'm not doing it.
